articles.title: The Barcelona salary ranking holds a surprise at the top: Who earns the same as Rodri?
articles.standfirst: The ranking of the highest salaries in the blaugrana squad reveals a particular coincidence at the very top and a significant gap starting from third place.
articles.summary: The ranking of the highest salaries in the blaugrana squad reveals a particular coincidence at the very top and a significant gap starting from third place.
articles.body:
The list of the highest-paid players at Barcelona has a tie at the top. Rodri shares first place with a teammate who is still building his career.

It is Lamine Yamal . Both are listed with an annual gross salary of €31.25 million.

A shared summit that says a lot about the new Barça

FC Barcelona heads into the 2026-27 season with one of the highest wage structures in LaLiga. The distribution of salaries offers a better understanding of the dressing room hierarchy and, at the same time, reflects the importance of its main stars within the project.

The list also reveals a clear commitment to the present and the future. While the club maintains significant contracts for its stars, several young players who have already established themselves among the elite are beginning to occupy privileged positions on the salary scale.

The name that shares first place

Lamine Yamal appears alongside Rodri at the top of the rankings. The forward earned that spot after becoming one of Barcelona's central pieces, despite his young age.

The figure becomes even more interesting when both players' careers are taken into account. Rodri arrived at Barcelona with an established track record at the elite level, while Yamal continues to make progress at a pace that is unusual for a player of his age.

The gap begins in third place

You have to go down to third place to find a different salary. Raphinha appears there with €20.84 million gross per year, well below the €31.25 million at the top.

Koundé, with €19.55 million, and Frenkie de Jong , with €18.02 million, round out the top five.

Pedri occupies sixth place with €16 million, followed by Karim Adeyemi, with €15.63 million. Anthony Gordon appears with €15 million, while Dani Olmo and Gavi round out the top 10 with €14 million and €11.73 million, respectively.

The ranking ends up leaving a particular snapshot of Barcelona : a footballer who arrived as an established star and one of the youngest talents in world football appear on the same salary tier.

Position Player Gross annual salary

1 Lamine Yamal €31.25 million

3 Raphinha €20.84 million

4 Jules Koundé €19.55 million

5 Frenkie de Jong €18.02 million

7 Karim Adeyemi €15.63 million

8 Anthony Gordon €15 million

articles.title: Balogun to the Premier League?: Million-dollar offer for the USMNT star
articles.standfirst: The American AS Monaco striker is at the center of one of the biggest sagas in the final hours of the transfer window after a formal move from England
articles.summary: The American AS Monaco striker is at the center of one of the biggest sagas in the final hours of the transfer window after a formal move from England
articles.body:
The transfer market in the Old Continent is entering its final hours under maximum tension, and Everton have burst onto the scene in the Principality . The Merseyside club submitted a formal offer to secure the services of Folarin Balogun , forward for the United States national team (USMNT), as confirmed by specialists in the field such as Fabrizio Romano and Belgian journalist Sacha Tavolieri.

At 25 years old and with a background at Arsenal, the striker looks very favorably on his return to British football . The club executives are stepping up contacts to fine-tune the financial details of a deal that has the player's own approval , as he is determined to rejoin the English ecosystem.

Goodison Park's bet to bolster its attack

At Goodison Park, there is an urgent need to strengthen the attack ahead of Beto's imminent departure to Fiorentina . With the financial room created by the Portuguese striker's exit, the Toffees' sporting director moved quickly and submitted a formal offer of around 18 million euros to Monaco's offices .

Although the American attacker has already agreed his personal terms with the Liverpool club, in the Principality they value the player at a figure close to 40 million in order to recoup the investment made at the time . The negotiation remains red hot with the intention of finding middle ground before the transfer window closes.

Balogun has not enjoyed official minutes at the start of this Ligue 1 season. After his summer participation with the Stars and Stripes team at the World Cup, the player completed his physical preparation while his entourage and the club sought a place for him at a top-level destination .

The key to unlocking Erik Lira's signing

The outcome of the Balogun case goes beyond British and French borders to directly affect Mexican football. And the striker's departure is essential for Monaco to free up a foreign-player spot in its squad .

That vacancy in the non-EU player quota is the one Erik Lira is waiting for. Monaco and Cruz Azul have agreed on the transfer of the Aztec midfielder, but the final signing remains conditional on the Principality club administratively clearing that regulatory margin .

The Monegasque sporting department has its back covered in the attacking department following the emergence of young German Paris Brunner, so the absolute priority is to speed up the American's departure and make room for the space Lira requires in midfield .

All on one card in the final stretch

Although siren calls were heard during the transfer window from clubs such as Tottenham, Aston Villa, or Newcastle, it has been Everton who have made the definitive move by putting the offer on the table .

The outcome is shaping up like a perfect carom for all the pieces on the board: Balogun secures his long-awaited ticket back to the Premier League, Everton makes up for Beto's departure, Monaco brings in a significant fee, and Erik Lira gets the green light to cross the pond . The clock is ticking, and the next few hours will finish sealing the fate of the deal.
